# Noobot v4.4.6

Changes since v4.4.5:

- Overhaul session storage with immutable indexes, incremental persistence, verified caches, lifecycle recovery, and execution log projections.
- Improve session persistence and message rendering performance, resource sharing, runtime event batching, and model connection reuse, with performance regression gates.
- Strengthen session log acknowledgements, rejection receipts, batch serialization, and WebSocket reconnection handling.
- Preserve historical attachment events and user interjection metadata during migration, with conflict detection and repeatable migration coverage.
- Fix Windows startup directory synchronization and execution index flushing while preserving file durability and startup diagnostics.
- Refine model configuration and summary flows, expand protocol and regression coverage, and align maintained documentation with CI and contribution workflows.
